Zucchini and Yam Fritters
By: Megan
Published: Wednesday, March 23, 2011 - 2:55pm

Ingredients




2 cups shredded zucchini
2 cups shredded yams (peeled first)
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
2 eggs
1/4 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon Mrs Dash original blend

Preparation

1 Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl. Scoop 1/4 cup mounds of mixture onto a greased baking sheet and flatten to shape into patties. Bake at 425F for 15 minutes. Flip and bake for another 10 minutes until golden brown.
